findings.claim: The strict installer never verifies the selected binary against any expected/certified hash before reporting success.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 4.1 requires the installer to "verify its expected version and hash"; the script only defines EXPECTED_VERSION, computes BUILD_HASH/STAGED_HASH/INSTALLED_HASH, and compares INSTALLED_HASH to STAGED_HASH, with no expected hash variable, manifest lookup, or comparison to config/prometheus-exec-binary.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Load the certified SHA-256 from the committed binary manifest or require PROMETHEUS_EXEC_EXPECTED_SHA256, compare the source/staged/installed hash to it, and fail before install/success output on mismatch.

findings.claim: The remote dispatch crate is pulled into the execution binary unconditionally instead of being isolated behind an estate/remote feature boundary.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 requires `exec-remote` to be "enabled only by the estate feature" and standalone/bundled-mobile profiles to not select remote dependencies; this file adds an unconditional `use prometheus_exec_remote::DispatchQueue;` and unconditional `inspect_remote_queue` code with no `cfg(feature = "estate")` or equivalent guard.
findings.suggested_fix: Gate the prometheus-exec-remote dependency, imports, DoctorConfig remote fields, CLI flags, and remote queue inspection behind the estate/remote feature, and ensure non-estate profiles compile without selecting the crate.

findings.claim: The phase-completion acceptance item remains unchecked in the committed task list.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 6.3 is listed as `[ ] 6.3 Install/sign/read back the final binary and generation, complete artifact-refiner and distinct-model review, verify/archive the OpenSpec change, and close the KBD phase with reflection`, and the diff hunk for tasks.md contains the same unchecked line.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete and archive the 6.3 closure evidence, then update the OpenSpec task to `[x]` in the same committed change.
